prs.title: Add streaming HTML insertion methods
prs.author: noamr
prs.body:
Introduce safe and unsafe streaming HTML parsing and insertion methods returning a `WritableStream`:
* `Element` & `ShadowRoot`: `streamHTML()`, `streamHTMLUnsafe()`, `streamAppendHTML()`, `streamAppendHTMLUnsafe()`, `streamPrependHTML()`, and `streamPrependHTMLUnsafe()`
* `NonDocumentTypeChildNode`: `streamBeforeHTML()`, `streamBeforeHTMLUnsafe()`, `streamAfterHTML()`, `streamAfterHTMLUnsafe()`, `streamReplaceWithHTML()`, and `streamReplaceWithHTMLUnsafe()`

Key behaviors and parser updates:
* **Stream operations**: `writeAlgorithm` and `closeAlgorithm` convert chunks to `DOMString`, append chunks (or an explicit `"EOF"` character on close) to the parser's input stream, and run the fragment parser. `closeAlgorithm` waits for any pending parser-blocking scripts via `fragment parser close promise`. `abortAlgorithm` aborts the fragment parser (deferring via `fragment parser abort requested` if currently running), marks open `script` elements on the stack as already started, and unblocks rendering on pending scripts.
* **Displaced reference child**: If `referenceChild` is no longer a child of `target` when a node would be inserted before it or when another chunk is written, `invalid reference child steps` error the stream (and reject `fragment parser close promise` if closing) with a `"HierarchyRequestError"` `DOMException` and abort the fragment parser. prs.title: Define responsive image source selection normatively
prs.author: noamr
prs.body:
Replace the implementation-defined choice in *select an image source from a source set* with deterministic selection matching implementations: deduplicate equal pixel densities keeping the earliest entry, sort ascending by pixel density, and pick the first candidate whose pixel density is greater than or equal to the document's device pixel ratio (or the last candidate if none qualify), with a "may" allowance for preferring an already-available higher-density candidate.

This PR reflects current behavior, and we can later reason about making the "MAY" part required/interoperable or changing the selection algorithm.

Also pass the document from `preload` links and return early if no source is selected.

Tests: https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/64665.

Fixes #13077.

---

- [x] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed):
   * Chromium (already shipped; author of #13077)
   * Gecko (already implements matching behavior)
   * WebKit (already implements matching candidate selection; zoom scaling tracked separately)
